treatment_summary: Continue ACE‑I and thiazide while adding amlodipine to improve BP control without worsening glucose tolerance. Start atorvastatin 20 mg for primary CVD prevention and metformin XR for high‑risk pre‑diabetes (once renal function confirmed). Replace oral naproxen with paracetamol and topical diclofenac for knee OA pain. Discontinue diphenhydramine and use melatonin for insomnia. Monitor BP, lipids, renal function, potassium, CK, and glucose per NICE guidelines, and address data gaps (eGFR, LFTs, QRISK, anemia work‑up) promptly.
